items.reason: A light 2% salicylic acid spray made for the chest, to help the look of spots on the chest and shoulders.

response.routine_note: Use a thin layer once a day on the upper chest and shoulders only, keep it off the breast and nipple area, and let it dry fully before feeding or skin-to-skin contact. Since you are breastfeeding, check with your midwife, doctor or pharmacist before starting, and see a dermatologist if the spots persist or worsen.
